title: Manager Confrontation
description: A middle-aged Black woman in a bright orange jacket stands prominently in the foreground, pointing her right index finger upward with an angry expression. Her jacket and the surrounding surreal background are covered in repeating orange text reading 'YOUR MANAGER' and 'E O L' amid floating flowers, calculators, and abstract shapes.
prompt: A surreal painting of an angry middle-aged Black woman wearing a bright orange jacket covered in repeating text that says YOUR MANAGER and E O L. She points her finger upward with a furious expression. The background is a chaotic dreamlike scene with floating colorful flowers, calculators, abstract shapes, and large fragmented text including the words EVOLVE and percentages. Vibrant yet unsettling color palette with orange, teal and purple tones.
